headline: Spotify adds new voices and quieter option to its AI DJ
summary: Spotify added new voice and personality options for its AI DJ feature, plus an option to turn off the between-song commentary.

claims.statement: Spotify added new voice options for its AI DJ and a way to turn off its commentary.

sources.quote: Spotify adds new voices for its AI DJ
You can also now listen to a DJ mix without the commentary.
Spotify’s AI DJ gets new voices, personalities, and an option for less chatter
Spotify Premium users can now customize their AI DJ with new voices with different personalities, or turn off the commentary between songs.
